title: Set up compliance (SOC 2-lite)
summary: Password manager, SSO, devices under management, privacy policy and DPA, then the SOC 2 Type I run.

parts.title: Set up a password manager
parts.guidance: Establish company-controlled password storage, recovery and access ownership before distributing shared credentials. Follow the password-manager workflow to configure the needed vaults and test member access. Document who can access each vault, who administers the account and how authorized recovery works.

parts.title: Set up SSO & access management
parts.guidance: Map identities, applications and access requirements before configuring single sign-on. Use the SSO workflow to test normal access, recovery and offboarding with a controlled group, preserving an approved recovery path. Record coverage and exceptions so later compliance evidence describes the systems actually governed by the identity setup.

parts.title: Set up device management (MDM)
parts.guidance: Inventory the devices and operating systems the company needs to manage, then agree enrollment and policy responsibilities. Follow the device-management workflow to test policies and recovery on representative devices before rollout. Keep enrollment, exception and verification records so the compliance review can distinguish managed devices from merely licensed or invited users.

parts.title: Publish privacy policy & DPA
parts.guidance: Document the company's actual data collection, uses, recipients and customer commitments before drafting privacy documents. Use the privacy-policy and DPA workflow to obtain the relevant legal and operational review. Approve the publication and contracting versions, retaining the facts behind the promises so subsequent controls and assurance work can be checked against them.

parts.title: Start SOC 2 Type I
parts.guidance: Define the intended assurance scope and the system description with the qualified audit team. Use the Type I workflow to gather evidence of implemented controls, review readiness and resolve findings. Retain the issued report and its scope after completion, making sure downstream sales or compliance claims match what was actually examined.
